prompts: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate one 16:9 landscape internal illustration, not a board. No text, numbers, logos, captions, frames, people, comic outlines, cel shading, or speech balloons. Entire objects within safe margins. Behind it, a receding organized library of translucent blue tiles containing varied smaller folded ribbon shapes, suggesting a large open collection of predicted protein structures. Clean coherent dimensional still life, strong depth, not a flat grid of icons. Models are conceptual, not a specific claimed molecule. Give the foreground protein enough visual weight and the collection enough space to show the relationship.
